items.final_answer: A DEDUCTIBLE IS THE DOLLAR AMOUNT THE PATIENT PAYS IN FULL EACH YEAR BEFORE INSURANCE CONTRIBUTES; COINSURANCE IS THE PATIENT’S SHARE (A PERCENTAGE) OF COSTS AFTER THAT DEDUCTIBLE HAS BEEN MET.
